javax.microedition.theme
Class ModifyNotSupportedException

java.lang.Object
  java.lang.Throwable
      java.lang.Exception
          javax.microedition.theme.ModifyNotSupportedException

public class ModifyNotSupportedException
extends java.lang.Exception

Thrown when a modify operation is attempted and the implementation does not support modify operations.

Modify operations are optional in the API. The relevant methods are listed in the main specification, in the "Specification compliance" section. Before calling these methods the application can check whether modify operations are supported by retrieving the value of the system property microedition.theme.modifysupported.
